tasks.gr11-globalisation-north-south-t4: Topic: Globalisation and the North-South divide. Grade 11 Economics CAPS. Cover globalisation as the increasing integration of the world's economies through trade, investment, capital flows, migration and technology diffusion. Key institutions: WTO (free trade rules), IMF, World Bank. SA's participation: BRICS, AGOA (preferential US market access). Benefits of globalisation: larger markets, technology transfer, investment. Costs for developing countries: unfair terms of trade, brain drain, loss of sovereignty. North-South divide: rich developed nations (North) vs poor developing nations (South); disparities in income, debt, technology and bargaining power.
tasks.gr11-environmental-sustainability-t4: Topic: Environmental deterioration and sustainability. Grade 11 Economics CAPS. Cover market failure from negative externalities (pollution costs not reflected in price), positive externalities, public goods and the tragedy of the commons. Climate change economic impacts: agricultural disruption, sea-level rise, infrastructure damage. Brundtland Commission (1987) definition of sustainable development: meeting present needs without compromising future generations. Green economy principles. SA policies: carbon tax (2019), National Environmental Management Act, renewable energy programmes (REIPPPP). International agreements: Kyoto Protocol (1997) and Paris Agreement (2015).
tasks.gr11-current-economic-issues-t4: Topic: Current South African economic issues and quantitative skills. Grade 11 Economics CAPS. Current issues: structural unemployment (skills mismatch, slow growth), Gini inequality, CPI inflation and SARB inflation targeting band (3–6%), rand/dollar exchange rate and its effect on imports/exports/inflation, economic impact of load-shedding on GDP. Quantitative skills: constructing and reading index numbers, converting nominal to real values using a price deflator, calculating GDP per capita, interpreting bar, line and pie graphs, writing structured data-response answers (describe the trend, calculate, explain the cause, evaluate a solution).
tasks.gr11-exam-revision-t4: Topic: Year-end examination revision for Grade 11 Economics CAPS. Consolidate Term 1 (factors of production, GDP/GNI, mixed economy, infrastructure), Term 2 (elasticity, market structures, Gini coefficient), Term 3 (developing economies, money and banking, micro-lending, SA in Africa), Term 4 (globalisation, sustainability, current issues). Practise integrated data-response questions combining graphs, tables and text extracts. Practise structured essay technique: introduction, three developed points each with SA evidence, conclusion. Cover both Paper 1 (macro) and Paper 2 (micro) exam formats.
